info.title: Working!!
info.synopsis: Working!! è ambientato in un ristorante per famiglie chiamato Wagnaria, nella prefettura di Hokkaido, dove il diciassettenne liceale Sota Takanashi deciderà  di lavorare part-time. A gestire le consumazioni dei clienti, oltre a lui, nello staff ci saranno altri ragazzi della sua età , tutti in qualche modo chiassosi, misteriosi e stravaganti.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Takanashi Souta, lover of all things small, is recruited by his tiny sempai Taneshima Popura to work at the family style restaurant Wagnaria. There he meets his new co-workers and begins to learn about their many quirks.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Souta meets Mahiru, who suffers from Androphobia, the fear of men. The rest of the staff sets them up to share shifts in a suicidal, for Souta at least, attempt to cure Mahiru.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Yachiyo the samurai sword carrying waitress reveals that she started carrying it to ward off bullies back in elementary school. At this time she encounters Kyoko who agrees to act as a body guard in exchange for Yachiyo's lunch. Otou Hyougo, the true restaurant manager, returns to the store after another unsuccessful search for his lost wife. His wife who has the worlds worst sense of direction got lost years ago while out shopping.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Takanashi takes the day off work to take care of his sick sister. The staff attempts to function without them and deal with Mahiru's fear of men with no male server to deal with the male customers.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Takanashi spends some quality time with his four quirky sisters; the boss, the drunk, the writer and the manipulative. Each in their own way is reliant on Takanashi to keep their family in order. White Day has arrived and Takanashi gifts Mahiru a bag of hair pins. This is the first White Day gift she has ever received. Later he runs into her on the street worried that she might attack some random male while walking around he escorts her home. On the way they run into his eldest sister Kazue. Mahiru get flustered and admits to "assaulting" Takanashi on a regular basis.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Otoo returns to Wagnaria once again this time bringing with him a new waitress, Yamada Aoi. Aoi tells a "tragic tale of woe" to which Takanashi responds that she is a liar. Reluctantly he ends up training Aoi in how to be a waitress. As the day progress she tries to assign the various staff members into a fake family structure.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The source of Mahiru's fear of men is revealed to be a plan concocted her father. Mahiru's father finds out that Takanashi gave her a gift for White Day and visits the restaurant to meet him. Mahiru, afraid that he has come to make her quit working there ask Takanashi to pretend to be a girl. Takanashi mans up and wears a skirt.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Kyouko is gone for a week on company business and in her absence Yachiyo attempts to "serve" Jun, which results in his heart being crushed even more. Later Nazuna sees Takanashi and Mahiru walking home together and bribes Kyouko to let her work at the restaurant for the day to spy on Mahiru. Mahiru eventually admits that she likes Takanashi, though Nazuna misinterprets this thinking that she was confirming that Takanashi was a masochist.

The staff of the restaurant fearing for Takanashi safety concoct an elaborate plan to have him cross dress so that Mahiru would think of him as a girl and not hit him. As the date comes to a close Takanashi comes to realize his true feelings for Mahiru and Mahiru receives the compliment of her life.

related.title: Wagnaria!!2
related.plot: Seconda serie per questo anime e per gli strambi dipendenti del Wagnaria, un classico ristorante per famiglie. In questa stagione assisteremo ad incidenti sempre più ridicoli, al consolidarsi di certe amicizie ed alla nascita di nuovi sentimenti. Inoltre, a Souta Takanashi ed ai suoi strampalati colleghi, si affiancheranno nuovi personaggi: tra questi ricordiamo Haruna, la moglie scomparsa di Hyougo Otoo, che ha il difetto di perdersi continuamente, e Kirio Yamada, il fratello maggiore di Aoi.

related.title: Wagnaria!!3
related.plot: Terza Stagione di "Working!" - Prendete un ristorante per famiglie, metteteci dentro lo staff più strampalato e divertente che possiate immaginare, shakerate bene, ed otterrete Working!! Seguiamo le vicende di Takanashi Souta, un normalissimo studente sedicenne, con la fissa per le lolite e per tutto ciò che è piccolo e kawai, reclutato per le strade nevose di una città  della prefettura di Hokkaido, dalla sua senpai Taneshima Popura ? dalla statura così ristretta, da essere scambiata per una ragazzina delle medie o peggio delle elementari ? per un lavoro part-time come cameriere al Wagnaria.

related.title: WWW.WAGNARIA!!
related.plot: Spin-off della serie "Working!!". Web-ban Working!! è un web manga che l?autrice pubblicava irregolarmente prima di iniziare la serie regolare. Personaggi e situazioni sono infatti differenti da quelli del manga ad esso successivo. La storia, che si svolge in un altro ristorante Wagnaria rispetto a quello della serie principale, si incentra sulle vicende di Daisuke Higashida che decide di andare a lavorare part-time al locale, a causa dei problemi economici della famiglia.
